chain.g: on this side (of), on the near or same side

ety.text: From Latin cis (“on this side (of), on the near or same side”). Doublet of he, it, here, hither, and hence.
Clipping of cisgender or cissexual, ultimately from Latin cis.

senses.d: Having two mutations on two genes on the same chromosome of a homologous pair.
Of the side of the Golgi apparatus nearer to the endoplasmic reticulum.
In (or constituting, forming, or describing) a double bond in which the greater radical on both ends is on the same side of the bond.
ex: However, a cis double bond causes a kink in the chain. (A cis double bond introduces a bend of about 42 into the linear hydrocarbon chain.)

senses.d: In (or constituting, forming, or describing) a coordination compound in which the two instances of a particular ligand are adjacent to each other.
ex: The cis effect is the labilization of ligands which are cis to certain other ligands.

senses.d: Cisgender (or sometimes cissexual): not trans (transgender or transsexual) nor non-binary.
